title: How a re-run CI job could undo a deploy.
description: A re-run of an old CI run passed shipper's gate and could put older code back. How we blocked it, checked twice, and made sure the check never blocks a fix.
lede: Pressing “re-run” on an old CI run is an ordinary thing to do. In shipper’s first week it could have put older code back in production. We closed that on 13 November.
summary: An old CI run, re-run, passed the gate because its commit was still on main. We compare it with what is live, check again inside the lock, and never let a failed compare stop a deploy.
